headline: Airbnb Implements New Rules Restricting Host Checkout Chores for Guests
summary: Airbnb has implemented new house rules restricting checkout chores that hosts can request from guests. The changes aim to reduce chores for travelers but may result in higher overall costs for customers.
why: Airbnb operates the premier worldwide marketplace for short-term lodging. Adjusting guest chore rules and cleaning requirements directly impacts listing competitiveness and platform fee structures.

impacts.name: Airbnb
impacts.why: The rollout of revised checkout policies directly alters guest and host pricing dynamics on Airbnb's platform.
